Private Function Show(e As Long, v As Variant) As String
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, t As String, d As Long
    If e <> 0 Then
        Show = "e" & e
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        t = TypeName(v) & " "
        For i = LBound(v, 1) To UBound(v, 1)
            For j = LBound(v, 2) To UBound(v, 2)
                t = t & " " & TypeName(v(i, j)) & ":" & CStr(v(i, j))
            Next
        Next
        Show = t
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Show = "Empty"
    Else
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function
Private Sub Base(ws As Object)
    ws.Range("A1:A5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(3, 1, 4, 1, 5))
    ws.Range("B1:B5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("x", "y", "z", "x", "w"))
End Sub
